name: Pintor Dalí · house-side path, lawn strip and kerb levels either side of the Cervantes apron
datum: Heights are relative to the visible Dalí parking surface (terrain siteY + daliSurface 0.272) at the lawn's parking edge. The lawn's parking edge stays flush with the parking. The house-side path sits `drop` below it.

station.note: Station a in metres along the path from the IMG_3082-3084 camera station (positive south).

dropTrust: PNOA-LiDAR 2020-21 (1 m ground) sampled every 3 m along the path and 3 m into the lawn. The path is 0.28-0.42 m below the lawn and parking from a = -30 to +9 (median 0.35), then the step closes to about 0 by a = 22 (0.17 at 12, 0.07 at 18, -0.05 at 24).

beds.name: Pintor Dalí · raised lawn bed and kerb wall north of the Cervantes apron
beds.trust: IMG_3089 and IMG_3086 show the strip north of the apron as a raised lawn bed. A white rendered kerb wall with a rounded top stands about 0.35-0.45 m above the tiled house-side path, and the lawn is level with its top. The laser survey gives the same step (0.35 m median). The bed ends at the apron in a white end wall with a rounded pier carrying a mailbox (IMG_3086, IMG_3087).

beds.name: Pintor Dalí · low kerb and rising lawn south of the Cervantes apron
beds.trust: South of the apron the path is edged by a low rounded white kerb about 0.12-0.15 m high (IMG_3082-3084), and the lawn behind it rises towards the parking. The survey puts the parking side 0.3-0.35 m above the path at the camera, so the lawn takes the rest of the rise across its width. The step closes about 22 m south of the camera.

extension.name: Dalí · lawn strip south of the traced crossing zone
Dalí · house-side footpath south of the traced crossing zone

extensionTrust: IMG_3082 shows the kerbed lawn strip and tiled path running on south past the end of the traced zone (z about 95). They are continued on the same bay-edge line with the traced widths (lawn 3.5 m, path 1.31 m) to 33.5 m along it, where the survey step closes. The end and the widths there are inferred, not photographed.

pier.name: Cervantes apron · rounded pier with mailbox at the raised bed's corner
pier.trust: The white pier with a rounded top and a wall-mounted white mailbox stands at the bed's parking-side corner by the apron (IMG_3086 left, IMG_3087). Its height is from the mailbox (about 0.4 m tall); the position is ±0.5 m.
